why: I checked every command in both briefs. `npm test` exists in package.json, and the Check 1 and Check 2 one-liners are valid and fit `node --input-type=module -e`. Check 3 is broken by its quoting. The JavaScript sits inside a bash double-quoted string, so the shell turns `'^#+\\s*'` and `'\\b'` into `'^#+\s*'` and `'\b'`. JavaScript then reads `'\s'` as just `s` and `'\b'` as a backspace character. The regex that gets built is `^#+s*capitalize<backspace>`, which never matches a heading like `## capitalize(s)`. So the command would always print every export as missing. Its PASS output, `missing: none`, can never appear, even when the README is correct. Run as written, that command doesn't work in this repository, so the criterion fails.
